Since the announcement, R completely checked out, he just wrote notes on the board, barely talked during class,and went to Disneyland instead of going to one of the review days for exams. Yesterday, as I was walking out Of R's classroom for the last time, I called "See you next year!" over my shoulder. My friends have told me that I'm the asshole for this, but I don't think so. AITA?
